comment: All candidates shared plain SGD, so optimizer progress could not distinguish them. The successful ordering favored normalized residual stacks E and A, then shallow normalized C, then shallow unnormalized D, with deep plain B last. K1061 helped identify B’s risk: substantial depth followed by unnormalized terminal blocks under low-progress SGD. K1009 supplied weak support for normalization in this regime; K1012 cautioned against treating equal progress estimates as equal losses. K1038 was only a caution about zero-LN smooth networks, not direct evidence for these candidates. This result supports the architecture bundle ordering on this split, but does not isolate normalization, activation, or residual effects.
